title: fix(plugin-form): the grouped dialog section bar is a jump bar, hidden when the sections fit
body:
Fixes #35472
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到的变化：分组新建/编辑弹窗里分组名那一行改成"跳转链接"样式（带井号的胶囊），不再像标签页；所有分组都放得下时这一行不再出现；点击后表单滚到该分组并短暂高亮分组标题。
- 为什么做：外部客户演示时反馈"切不了标签页"——那一行其实是滚动跳转，内容放得下时点了毫无反应，看起来像坏掉的标签页。
- 出错会怎样：只影响分组弹窗与整页表单上方的跳转条；作者明确配置的标签页布局和记录详情页不受影响；可直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

**Which row it is (A1).** The row is not the `tabbed` content layout. With no authored form view, the console's layout resolver returns no `contentLayout` (only a `tabbed` form view maps to `'tabbed'`), so `ModalForm` takes the stacked arm: each group becomes a `section-divider` heading in one form, and the form renderer reports the drawn headings into `FormSectionNavContext`. `ModalForm` draws `FormSectionNav` from that report between the header and the scrolling body whenever two or more headings are reported. That component is a scroll-anchor jump bar (its own docblock: "A click scrolls to the section"; the 35092 fix made the jump scroll only the form's scroller). It was styled as underlined tabs, and when every group fit the body the jump had nothing to scroll, so only the highlight moved.

**Choice: (a), a jump bar made honest.** The derived default is meant to stack every group (the stacked arm, the scroll spy, the error counts per section, the collapse of a trailing group); the tab strip with mounted panels already exists for an authored `tabbed` layout and is untouched. So:

- `FormSectionNav` is drawn as jump links: a `#` glyph and a rounded pill per entry, the current one filled, instead of underlined tabs on a baseline.
- It is hidden while every section fits its scroller (`scrollHeight` not above `clientHeight`), re-read through a `ResizeObserver` on the form's field grid and the scroller plus window resize, so it comes back when a section unfolds or the window shrinks. An unmeasured box (height 0) is never judged to fit. The fit is read in a layout effect, so a fitting dialog never paints the bar first.
- A click marks the heading it jumped to with `data-section-jumped` for `JUMP_MARK_MS` (1.6 s); the heading row in `form.tsx` styles that attribute (primary underline, tinted band, fading). A jump to a heading already in view therefore still shows where it went.
- `ModalForm` takes the header's separator decision from the bar (`onDrawnChange`), so a fitting dialog keeps its header line.
- The same component serves the full-page `ObjectForm` bar, so the same rules apply there.

Unchanged: the authored `tabbed` layout (renderer-owned `fieldTabs`, panels force-mounted), the record detail page (it renders `plugin-detail` sections and never mounts `FormSectionNav` or the form `SectionDivider`), collapsed groups, the scroll spy and the error counts.

## Tests

`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/FormSectionNav.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe in the shared harness, with a recording `ResizeObserver` stub (the test DOM does no layout):

- fixture scroller: no bar while two sections fit a 600 box, the bar once the content grows to 1400, gone again at 600;
- fixture scroller: a click marks the heading it jumped to, one already in view included; a second click moves the mark; the mark clears after `JUMP_MARK_MS`;
- CONTROL: a trailing collapsed section stays folded until its own entry is clicked, then unfolds and is marked;
- record dialog: every section fits the body: no bar, the header gets its `border-b` back, all four headings still drawn;
- record dialog: the sections overflow: the bar is drawn, a click scrolls the form scroller by the expected distance and marks the heading;
- CONTROL: an authored tabbed dialog keeps its tab strip, a tab press switches the active panel, no bar.

`ui/e2e/form-section-nav-dialog-scroll-35092.spec.ts`: only the harness class list is updated for the bar's new classes (the spec compiles Tailwind for the classes it names).

## Acceptance notes

- The full-page form gets the same fit rule; it was not measured in a browser (the card's browser reading is the dialog).
- The mark is an attribute the bar sets on the heading element directly; React does not manage that attribute, so a re-render leaves it alone and the timer clears it.
- No new i18n key: the bar's visible text is the section labels it already had.
- Browser readings were taken against the Console's Vite dev server (source), not a `console:build` dist.

## Browser reading (A4)

Headless Chromium, 1280x900, deviceScaleFactor 2, showcase app, own backend on a random port with `--fresh`, Console Vite dev server pointed at it. The "before" leg swapped the three changed source files back to their `origin/main` blobs (hash-checked) and restored them (`git diff HEAD` empty afterwards). Screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat5/area-ux/ux-2/a4-35472/`.

| Object | Tree | Bar | Click on last entry | Scroller scrollTop | Heading marked |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `showcase_category` (2 groups, no authored form) | origin/main | drawn as tabs | highlight moved to Display | 0 -> 0 (scrollHeight 290 = clientHeight 290) | n/a |
| `showcase_category` | this PR | not drawn; header keeps its separator | n/a | 0 | n/a |
| `showcase_account` (4 groups) | origin/main | drawn as tabs | highlight moved to Other | 0 -> 165 | no |
| `showcase_account` | this PR | drawn as jump pills | highlight moved to Other | 0 -> 166 | yes |

The origin/main category reading is the card's defect: a tab-looking row whose click changes only the highlight because the body has nothing to scroll.
